title: 5 keys
author: gwai77
rules:
• Place the digits 1 to 9 in each row, column and box 3x3 without repetition.
• Cells connected by a German whisper line must have a difference of at least 5.
• Clues outside the grid indicate the digit which has to be placed in the Nth cell in the corresponding direction, where N is the digit placed in the first cell in that direction.
• Cells separated by a white dot must be consecutive.Not all dots are given.
